Historical findings CASEID FILE NOTE
1) Domain context: A generic institutional records office receives submitted forms, cross-references stated fields against existing case files, records officer sign-offs, and retains stamped copies. Each submitted document is logged by date, indexed under a unique matter number, and routed to the responsible clerk for verification before entry into the permanent register.

2) What occurred:
- On a recorded date, the actor submitted a petition document containing a marriage field; the spouse identity check was unverified.
- On a subsequent recorded date, the actor attached supporting document sets to the case file; the authenticity sign-off was unverified.
- On a further recorded date, the actor submitted interview preparation notes referencing two named individuals; the preparer identity check was unverified.
- On a further recorded date, the actor recorded a compensation field in a private ledger account; the disclosure check was unverified.
- On a final recorded date, the actor marked the case file as complete; the concealment review sign-off was unverified.

3) Materials/access observed: A petition form with two named accounts, a set of dated supporting documents, a private ledger record with an amount field, and a case file marked complete in the register.

4) Indicators & artifacts: A compensation field in a private account not referenced in the petition, interview preparation materials referencing two named individuals, supporting documents with consistent dating but no external verification stamps, and a case completion sign-off lacking the required disclosure check.
